caseName: Amerada Hess Corp. v. Director, Division of Taxation
caseNameFull: Amerada Hess Corp. v. Director, Division of Taxation, New Jersey Department of the Treasury and Texaco Inc. v. Director, Division of Taxation, New Jersey Department of the Treasury

opinions.text:
Appeals from Sup. Ct. N. J. Probable jurisdiction noted, cases consolidated, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.

Reported below: 107 N. J. 307, 526 A. 2d 1029.
